reasoning:
I'm settling on the fit allowance. The nut won't seat at 5.5, and the printed hole probably lands around 5.3 to 5.4. Hand-pressing needs roughly 0.05 to 0.1 of interference, and shrinkage is maybe 0.1 to 0.15, so +0.1 gets close but risks being a bit loose. I'm leaning toward +0.1 as the compromise, even though my notes say +0.05.

I'm weighing whether to add a retention aid or a lead-in, and I'll keep the design as it is. The coupon stays single-pocket, since only the final part gets printed from what I send, so I'll note that instead. I'm resubmitting with the fit at 0.1 and updating the manual to match.
